story: In the afternoon, Aiko wears a red T-shirt. She and Dan have a conversation about dinner. Dan brings delicious food to fill the plates. He is sure the meal will become great, but work is not at an end.
title: A Nice Dinner
setting: A bright dining room in a house.

characters.name: Aiko
characters.look: a young girl with short black hair wearing a red T-shirt

characters.name: Dan
characters.look: a tall man with brown hair and a blue shirt

sentences.en: Aiko wears a bright red T-shirt today.
sentences.zh: Aiko今天穿着一件鲜红色的T恤衫。
sentences.scene_prompt: Aiko, a young girl with short black hair, wears a bright red T-shirt.

sentences.en: It is a sunny afternoon in the room.
sentences.zh: 房间里是一个阳光明媚的下午。
sentences.scene_prompt: Sunlight shines into a bright room during the afternoon.

sentences.en: Aiko and Dan have a long conversation.
sentences.scene_prompt: Aiko and Dan sit at a table having a conversation.

sentences.en: They talk about the colour of the food.
sentences.scene_prompt: Aiko and Dan look at many colourful vegetables on the table.

sentences.en: Dan will bring the food upstairs now.
sentences.zh: Dan现在要把食物拿到楼上去。
sentences.scene_prompt: Dan carries a tray of food towards the stairs upstairs.

sentences.en: He wants to prepare a delicious dinner.
sentences.zh: 他想要准备一顿美味的晚餐。
sentences.scene_prompt: Dan stands in the kitchen preparing a delicious dinner.

sentences.en: He will fill the plates with rice.
sentences.scene_prompt: Dan uses a spoon to fill a white plate with rice.

sentences.en: The meal will become very good soon.
sentences.zh: 这顿饭很快就会变得非常好吃。
sentences.scene_prompt: Dan looks at the steaming food, and it looks great.

sentences.en: He looks up at the tall clock.
sentences.zh: 他抬头看着那个高大的时钟。
sentences.scene_prompt: Dan looks up at a tall clock on the wall.

sentences.en: The food is not bad at all.
sentences.scene_prompt: Dan tastes the food and smiles.

sentences.en: But the work is not at an end.
sentences.scene_prompt: Dan looks at the messy kitchen, knowing there is more to do.
